source_title: RECPDCL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 32 Senior Executive, Deputy Executive and More Posts - FreeJobAlert.Com
source_excerpt:
REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited (RECPDCL) is hiring experienced professionals for 32 fixed-term posts. The posts are Senior Executive (Tech.) - Lead Verifier, Deputy Executive (Tech.), Assistant Executive (Tech.) and Assistant Executive (Fin.). Monthly consolidated pay runs from Rs. 62,000 to Rs. 1,55,250. Applications are made online only, from 27 October 2026 (12:00 PM) until 17 November 2026 (06:30 PM).
RECPDCL Assistant Executive and Other Posts Recruitment 2026 Overview
The official notification does not specify the application fee.
REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited, formerly REC Power Distribution Company Limited, is a wholly owned subsidiary of REC Ltd., a "Maharatna CPSE" under the Ministry of Power, Government of India. It provides consultancy across the power sector. Its work includes project management consultancy, smart metering, smart grid, solar projects, third-party quality inspection, energy audit, DPRs and power transmission projects. It also works with Government of India schemes such as R-APDRP, IPDS, PMDP, RFMS and NFMS.
RECPDCL Assistant Executive and Other Posts Vacancy Details 2026
* For these posts, salary is negotiable for deserving candidates. It depends on experience, profile and performance in the interview, subject to internal guidelines.
Deputy Executive (Tech.)/L-3: Distribution Expert, Renewable Energy, Utility Coordinator and Electrical (Transmission), 18 vacancies
Assistant Executive (Tech.)/L-2 (Utility Engineer), 08 vacancies
The figures include 04 backlog vacancies: 02 for Deputy Executive (Tech.)/L-3 (ST: 01, SC: 01) and 02 for Assistant Executive (Tech.)/L-2 (OBC-NCL: 02). The number of positions may increase or decrease depending on RECPDCL's requirements.
Vacancies reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities are included within these numbers; the official notice gives the break-up.
The pay is a monthly consolidated amount (L5: Rs. 1,55,250 for Compliance and Rs. 1,35,000 for Offset; L3: Rs. 85,000; L2: Rs. 62,000). Other benefits are paid on top of it, as admissible under company policy:
Mobile set, laptop and office bag reimbursement
RECPDCL Assistant Executive and Other Posts Eligibility 2026
Senior Executive (Tech.) - Lead Verifier/L-5: maximum 55 years
Deputy Executive (Tech.)/L-3: maximum 40 years
Assistant Executive (Tech.) and (Fin.)/L-2: maximum 35 years
Age and experience are counted as on 17 November 2026, the last date for applications. Only Indian nationals can apply.
Senior Executive (Tech.) - Lead Verifier/L-5 (Compliance Mechanism)
Qualification: As per the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (Qualification for Accredited Energy Auditors and Maintenance of the List) Regulations, 2010.
Experience: 13 years of post-qualification experience.
Mandatory certifications: Accredited Energy Auditor by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), and Lead Verifier certification for ISO 14064-1/2/3.
Senior Executive (Tech.) - Lead Verifier/L-5 (Offset Mechanism)
Qualification: Engineering Graduate (Bachelor of Engineering/Bachelor of Technology) or equivalent, or Bachelor of Science or equivalent.
Experience: 13 years, including at least 5 years in validation and/or verification as a team member in CDM or VCM activities.
Mandatory certification: Lead Verifier certification for ISO 14064 1/2/3.
Proven competence in leading a verification team
Generic verification concepts: evidence gathering, risk management, auditing techniques and level of assurance
Knowledge and experience of energy and GHG accounting and management, and of GHG emission sources and technologies
Development and auditing of emission factors and calculation methods
Statistical uncertainty analysis of GHG calculations
Monitoring and reporting of GHG emissions
Knowledge of the Energy Conservation (Amendment) Act, 2022, the Environment Protection Act, 1986 and the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme, 28/06/2023
Communication, analytical, statistical and financial skills
Collecting information through interviewing, observation and review of records
Data, information and system auditing techniques
Risk assessment and data sampling techniques
Judging whether gathered evidence is accurate and sufficient
Sector-specific monitoring and reporting knowledge for the accreditation scope
Assessing conformity with the procedures of CCTS mechanisms
Deputy Executive (Tech.)/L-3: minimum 6 years of post-qualification experience

Experience: power distribution work such as construction, consultancy, PMA, or monitoring of 33/11 KV and above substations, distribution lines and distribution transformer works.

Percentages are not rounded up: 59.9% is treated as less than 60%.
Qualifications must be from institutions recognised by UGC/AICTE or the appropriate statutory authority. RECPDCL decides on equivalence.
Teaching experience, internships, induction and training periods do not count as experience.
OBC candidates who are not in the Non-Creamy Layer must apply as unreserved.

Other reservation and relaxation (including EWS and Ex-Servicemen) follows Government of India guidelines.
Reserved-category candidates who apply against an unreserved post are treated as General.
See the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post.
Shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview. It is held at the RECPDCL Corporate Office or online, as the management decides. Offers go out in order of merit, based on the number of vacancies. If many applications come in, RECPDCL may use higher shortlisting criteria. The indicative shortlisting ratios are:
Shortlisting Marks: Engineering Discipline (100 marks)
Shortlisting Marks: Finance & Accounts Discipline (100 marks)
Marks are given only for qualifications and experience backed by documents submitted by the last date. Experience counts only if it clearly relates to the advertised post. A tie at the cut-off is broken in this order:
Higher marks/CGPA in the essential qualification
Longer total post-qualification experience
If the tie remains, all tied candidates may be shortlisted.
Tenure: 1 year at first, which may be extended based on need and performance, up to a maximum of 4 years and 6 months.
Nature of the job: purely temporary and not against any permanent vacancy. It gives no claim to regular employment at RECPDCL.
Place of posting: Corporate Office, Gurugram and/or project offices across India. Management may post selected candidates to any office, project or unit.
Lead Verifier posts: the posting is decided by organisational and project needs and told to candidates at the interview or at joining.
Medical fitness: engagement depends on a medical fitness test, with no relaxation in standards.
Travel and stay: interview candidates get to-and-fro fare by the shortest route on proof of journey, as per policy. Lodging is not paid.
Government and PSU staff: must apply through proper channel, or give an NOC at the interview or a relieving order at joining.
Canvassing: any form of canvassing leads to disqualification.
How to Apply for RECPDCL Assistant Executive and Other Posts Recruitment 2026
Open the career page at www.recpdcl.in and register on the online recruitment portal with a user name and email ID. Neither can be changed after registration.
Use the link sent to your registered email to set a password and activate your login.
Log in and click "Apply" against the post you want. You can apply for only one post.
Upload scanned documents, a recent passport-size colour photograph and your signature. All files must be in .jpg format, between 10KB and 100KB.
Fill in and submit the form before 06:30 PM on 17 November 2026. Corrections are not possible after submission.
Keep the acknowledgement and a printout of the preview page. You do not need to send a hard copy.
Use a valid email ID and mobile number and keep them for at least a year, because all communication goes to that email. The portal works best in Chrome. Incomplete applications are rejected summarily.

Class X certificate or birth certificate as proof of date of birth

Disability certificate showing the type and percentage of disability
Pass certificate, mark sheets and degree certificate showing class/division/CGPA/percentage, mode, duration and specialisation. If no percentage is shown, also upload the university's CGPA conversion formula.
Certificates and mark sheets for other qualifications
No Objection Certificate, if you work in a Government department, PSU or autonomous body
Lead Verifier posts only: the certifications listed above, plus details in the Annexure-A format (energy audit/GHG audit experience) or the Annexure-B format (CDM/VCM carbon market and GHG project experience)
Work-experience proof for each job, starting with the current one: Appointment or joining order, or first pay slip Experience certificate showing post, period, CTC and area of work Last three months' pay slips CTC proof with ITR or Form-16 A Relieving order

Have questions about eligibility , dates , or vacancies ? Found incorrect information ? The FreeJobAlert team is here to help.
Q1. How many vacancies are there in this recruitment?
There are 32 posts across nine post-discipline rows. The biggest group is Deputy Executive (Tech.) Utility Coordinator, with 11 vacancies.
Q2. What is the salary of an Assistant Executive at RECPDCL?
Rs. 62,000 a month (consolidated) at Level L2. It is negotiable for deserving candidates, and benefits such as mobile and laptop reimbursement are paid on top.
No. Each candidate may apply for only one post. If you apply for more, RECPDCL may consider any one application at its discretion.
Age and experience are counted as on 17.11.2026. The upper age limits are 35 years for L-2, 40 years for L-3 and 55 years for L-5 posts.
No. It is a fixed-tenure engagement of 1 year to start, which can be extended up to a maximum of 4 years and 6 months. It gives no right to regular employment.
Q6. Where will the Electrical and Civil (Transmission) posts be based?
Both are in Ladakh. A hardship allowance for the Ladakh posting is paid on top of the consolidated pay, as admissible.
Q7. How will candidates be shortlisted for the interview?
If many applications come in, candidates are scored out of 100. Engineering candidates are marked on qualifying-exam percentage (35), higher qualification (25) and extra experience (40). Shortlisting goes up to 6 or 10 candidates per vacancy.
Q8. Does internship or teaching experience count?
No. Teaching experience, internships, induction and training periods are not counted as experience.
Q9. Will I get travel expenses for the interview?
Yes. You get to-and-fro fare from your starting station or mailing address, whichever is nearer, by the shortest route, on proof of journey. Lodging is not paid.
